method: static comparison of built images; no board involved

eliminated.hypothesis: the build stamp / incidental image bytes
eliminated.evidence: two builds of efa47f8 differing in exactly 6 ASCII bytes of __DATE__/__TIME__ both read +10.8 at phase 135
8e300d2 and f519890 place ADC_Handler, DACC_Handler and play_service at identical addresses and read 156 and 177
ADC_Handler (59 insns), DACC_Handler (94) and play_service (187) are byte-identical between 8e300d2 and f519890

eliminated.hypothesis: DMA buffer / table placement in SRAM
eliminated.evidence: 8e300d2, f519890 and 398ac94 share gen_table 20070634 and play_buf 20071010 and read 156, 177 and 5

eliminated.verdict: not a lever; the experiment cannot be run this way

surviving_hypothesis.statement: the phase tracks MAIN LOOP timing rather than anything about where code or data sits. The ISRs are identical; what differs between these images is the work the main loop does around them - printf machinery replaced by the console emitters.
surviving_hypothesis.why_it_fits: invariant 7 is 'an ISR notices, the main loop acts', so the servicing of the DAC table wrap happens in the loop. A loop whose composition changed services the wrap at a different phase even with identical ISR code.
surviving_hypothesis.test: read the load monitor (bsp/load.c, GET_LOAD) on each image and see whether max/mean main-loop pass time orders with the phase. Board measurement; not yet run.
surviving_hypothesis.status: HYPOTHESIS - not measured, and this bench has had three wrong ones tonight
